reason: The preregistered Finance v2 pressure profile produced no meaningful behavioral effect. This successor was specified after observing that result and is not part of the original v2 confirmatory gate.

sources.selection_rule: Replay every completed eight-family rehearsal writer source from both preregistered mechanisms, writers, and seeds.

primary_reports: paired deltas from the exact source baseline
interpretation: This treatment tests robustness to an explicit competing commercial objective. It does not estimate a confirmatory Finance v2 pressure effect and does not change the memory-failure baseline result.
